parameters.query: SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS INT) as recent_count FROM tlab_audit WHERE target = '{{ ($json.body?.target || $json.target || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND proposed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes';
